verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official MCP server at mcp.poly.app/mcp and a scriptable `poly` CLI. Its agent skill explicitly teaches agents to "search, read, create, update, and organize" Poly files, and the Claude Code plugin gives "full access to your Poly files," so agents can both read and write without the GUI. Notes such as journal entries are Markdown files in that storage. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration, an explicit documented list of MCP write tools (write over MCP is only implied by the rm/archive rule), a fully headless first-time auth path (OAuth opens a browser), and a public REST/OpenAPI vendor API (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent or assistant can read AND write my notes headlessly — through a documented local API, vendor API, or MCP server — without me touching the GUI

citations.quote: MCP clients can connect to `https://mcp.poly.app/mcp` (streamable HTTP).
teaches an agent how to search, read, create, update, and organize your Poly files by composing `poly` commands.
Give Claude Code persistent context and full access to your Poly files.
Irreversible actions are blocked over MCP: rm archives files (reversible)
New journal entries are Markdown files synced to your **Mind** folder.
